notes: The exact application deadline for the winter semester 2026 is stated only as '2. Mai bis 30. Juni' without a year, so the intake dates are left null. The tuition is stated as none per semester; the semester contribution of 70 EUR and the 80 EUR application fee for non-EU applicants are not tuition fees. Language proficiency in English B2 and German A1 is required for admission; these are admission requirements, not recommended. Prior study of 12 years is inferred from the requirement of a general university entrance qualification and the possibility of attending a Studienkolleg if the school-leaving certificate does not grant direct access. For the documents, the page lists the required documents for a bachelor application and names the tabular CV and the university entrance qualification; the VPD (Vorprüfungsdokumentation) from uni-assist is also required for foreign educational certificates. The programme page https://www2.daad.de/deutschland/studienangebote/international-programmes/en/detail/9225/ is the DAAD database entry for Software Design International; the university's own programme page https://www.th-ab.de/studium/vor-dem-studium/studiengaenge-von-a-z/software-design-international/ was not among the supplied pages.
